_comment: Single source of truth for every tunable knob /simulate's extended mode uses (odds, thresholds, cooldowns, the lifespan range) - scripts read this via scripts/lore/tuning.py instead of hardcoding their own defaults, and .claude/skills/simulate/SKILL.md's orchestration prose points here rather than restating numbers.
